data.name: Welcome_Lead
data.value: This wizard installs StudyScope {version} on your computer – the learning software for chatting with your documents and studying with flashcards, supported by AI. From your documents, StudyScope also creates mind maps, presentations, quizzes, data tables, reports, audio summaries to listen to and narrated explainer videos.

data.name: Welcome_NoPayloadText
data.value: This setup was built without the StudyScope program files (developer build). Use the setup created by the build script.

data.name: Welcome_UpdateText
data.value: The setup updates the installation in {folder} to version {version}.

data.name: Welcome_PerUser
data.value: Installs for your user account only – no administrator rights required

data.name: Welcome_KeepsData
data.value: Your profiles and settings are kept during updates

data.name: Welcome_Uninstall
data.value: Can be uninstalled at any time via the setup

data.name: Welcome_Ffmpeg
data.value: Optional: with the free program ffmpeg, StudyScope exports videos as MP4 and audio as MP3 (not installed with StudyScope)

data.name: Folder_LeadUpdate

data.name: Folder_DataSeparateText
